risks: only 3 validation windows: weight estimation is high variance
diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong upward trend (a net rise of ~143% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.329), which favours a weighted combination.

decision.justification: Selected 'best_single FT_rf' (an agent proposal) as the best of 22 backtested attempts, score 0.308. Series context: trend strength 0.95 and seasonal strength 0.134; model ranking is moderate across windows (Kendall tau 0.329); 6 of 19 models carry independent error; relative error spread across the pool is 7.481.
